You have nothing to fear from u

scope.zh: “逐水舰队”（纳马里安游牧民）穿过银河：首次联络、沿途的请求（收留人口、让出行星、卖船）、外交菜单、被攻击时的反应与离开。
scope.en: The Namarian nomad fleet "Pursuing Waters" crossing the galaxy: first contact, requests along the way (take in pops, cede a planet, sell ships), the diplomacy menu, reactions to attacks and the farewell.

uncertain: namarian.15 (war mission) and other hidden fleet events were not expanded.

texts.zh:
愿凉爽的白天和温暖的夜晚一直伴你左右，[Root.GetAdj][Root.GetRulerTitle]。我们是[contact_speaker_leader.GetName]。我们代表游牧舰队，逐浪者舰队上所有的纳马里安之魂发声。

你不必对我们心存恐惧，我们的舰队无意对天体进行争夺。我们只要求受到尊重，旅程不受到妨碍。
texts.en:
Cold days and warm nights upon you, [Root.GetAdj] [Root.GetRulerTitle]. We are [contact_speaker_leader.GetName]. We speak on behalf of all the Namarian souls aboard the collected ships of the Pursuing Waters, our nomadic fleet.

You have nothing to fear from us, as the fleet has no interest in orb-bound affairs. We ask only that you respect our autonomy and do not hinder us on our journey.

tooltips.zh: [contact_empire.GetName]对我们的外交策略毫不关心。
tooltips.en: The [contact_empire.GetName] care little for our diplomatic maneuvering.

tooltips.zh: 我们要与[contact_empire.GetName]寻求友好的关系。
tooltips.en: We shall seek friendly relations with the [contact_empire.GetName].

label.en: We wish for nothing but to be friends, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
We are delighted to meet you, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
Our citizens all send their regards, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

label.zh: 这次会面真的是上天的赐福。
label.en: This meeting is surely a blessing.

label.zh: 合作共赢对我们都有益处。
label.en: Co-operation will surely benefit us all.
Love is friendship set to music, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

label.zh: 我们可以相互学习共同进步，[contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
label.en: We could learn much from each other, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

label.zh: 如果同心协力我们便可成就伟业，[contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！
作为一起探索宇宙的伙伴，我们向你们表示致敬。
label.en: As fellow star explorers, we salute you.

label.zh: 向同为星际旅者朋友的你们表示问候。
label.en: We greet you as equals and friends, star travelers.
We share the same divine heritage, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

label.zh: 此次相遇对我们双方都大有裨益。
label.en: We all have much to gain from this encounter.

label.zh: 结交新朋使人臻于至善。
label.en: New friends bring one closer to divinity.

label.zh: 很高兴，我们终于与同族的其他人团聚。
label.en: We are glad to finally be reunited with the rest of our species.

label.zh: 我们作为一体向你表达问候与友谊，[contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
label.en: Our collective greets you in friendship, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

label.zh: 目标判定为非有机体。停止行动。
label.en: Target identified as non-organic. Standing down.
Praise the divine for this meeting!

label.zh: 我方全体公民向你们问好。
label.en: Our citizens greet you in peace.

label.zh: 欢迎你，以及你奇异的亲族。
label.en: Greetings to you, and your odd kin.

label.zh: 别指望得到我们的善待！
label.en: We do not take kindly to your sort!

tooltips.zh: [contact_empire.GetName]对我们的外交策略毫不关心。
tooltips.en: The [contact_empire.GetName] care little for our diplomatic maneuvering.

tooltips.zh: 我们要设法与[contact_empire.GetName]保持距离，他们在我们这的间谍网增长-33%。
tooltips.en: We shall seek to distance ourselves from the [contact_empire.GetName], giving them -33% Spy Network growth on us.

label.zh: 别指望得到我们的善待！
label.en: We do not take kindly to your sort!

label.zh: 外星人，不要干涉我们的事业。
label.en: Do not interfere with our endeavors, aliens.

label.zh: 你们这些卑微的存在并不会威胁到我们[Root.GetRulerTitle]。
label.en: Your kind will not threaten our [Root.GetRulerTitle].

label.zh: 我们追求真正的平等——别挡道。
label.en: We pursue true equality - do not stand in our way.
We have no desire for conflict, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

label.zh: 不要干涉神的旨意，[contact_speaker.GetAdj]机械们。
label.en: Do not interfere with divine providence, [contact_speaker.GetAdj] machines.

label.zh: 你们的道德准则对我们而言毫无意义！
label.en: We do not care for your frivolous morality!

label.zh: 我们会为自己的生存的权利而战斗，[contact_speaker.GetSpeciesName]。
label.en: We will fight for our right to exist, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesName].

label.zh: 我们将实现统一共荣，不要妨碍！
label.en: We will achieve unity, do not stand in our way!

label.zh: 你们终将接受上上善道。
label.en: You will embrace the greater good, eventually.

label.zh: 你看待事物的视角早晚会与我们一致的。
label.en: You will come to see things our way, in the end.

label.zh: 似乎魂灵们在此次会议中颇为不悦，[contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
label.en: The spirits do not look favorably on this meeting, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

label.zh: 滚出我们的视线，否则就开战！
label.en: Keep out of our way or we will make you!

tooltips.zh: [contact_empire.GetName]对我们的外交策略毫不关心。
tooltips.en: The [contact_empire.GetName] care little for our diplomatic maneuvering.

tooltips.zh: 我们要提防[contact_empire.GetName]的敌意，我们在他们那的间谍网增长提升+33%。
tooltips.en: We shall prepare for hostilities with the [contact_empire.GetName], giving us +33% Spy Network growth on them.

label.zh: 滚出我们的视线，否则就开战！
label.en: Keep out of our way or we will make you!

label.zh: 目标已确认。搜寻并摧毁。
我们都是虚空的一部分，弱者。
label.en: We are the instrument of the void, weaklings.

label.zh: 亵渎神灵必受狱火之焚烧，外星异端！
没有灵魂的机械！不要阻碍我们。
label.en: Soulless constructs! Do not stand in our way.

label.zh: 你们这群歪门邪道的外星渣滓！
label.en: You walk the path of heresy, alien scum!
You will find yourself no match for us, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

label.zh: 我们会在战场上恭候你们！
label.en: We shall properly greet you in battle!
Our sacred arms shall not waver, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

label.zh: 尊重我们的主权，否则后果自负。

label.en: You must throw away your old ways, [contact_speaker.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

label.zh: 你迟早要成为我们的朋友，无论你自己是否愿意。
label.en: You will be our friends, whether you want it or not.

label.zh: 你迟早要屈膝于[Root.GetRulerTitle]，无论你自己是否愿意。
label.en: You will serve the [Root.GetRulerTitle], whether you wish to or not.

label.zh: 我们要把你们整个消灭。
label.en: As one, we will destroy you.

texts.zh: 你们好，[Root.GetAdj][Root.GetRulerTitle]。我们有个请求。在我们穿过漫漫虚空的旅途中，我们中的一些人民心生倦怠，眼中失去了目标。我们不是暴君，因此不会强迫任何人跟随我们完成旅途。所以我们在此请求：你们可以接收上述船员吗？让他们栖息在你们的[NomadMissionPlanet.GetName]上，可以吗？
texts.en: Greetings again, [Root.GetAdj] [Root.GetRulerTitle]. We have a request for you. As we travel the void some of our people grow weary and lose sight of our goal. We are no tyrants, we force no one to see our quest to the end. So we ask of you: will you take some of our people in? To dwell on your orb, the one named [NomadMissionPlanet.GetName]?

responses.zh: 旅途漫漫，很可能我们一生都无法到达终点。有人想要寻找在有生之年能够到达的目标，而不是在无尽的旅途中耗尽此生。
responses.en: The fleet's journey has been a long one. And it will not likely end within our lifetime. The discontent among us want another purpose in their lives other than searching the stars for our goal.

label.zh: 他们要怎么适应我们的社会？
label.en: How will they adapt to our society?

responses.zh: 他们是一群不仅唯心还追求所谓平等的懦夫，至于他们能否和你们友好相处那就是你们自己的决断了。
responses.en: They are a spiritual and egalitarian crowd, how well that meshes with your tribe is for you to discern.

responses.zh: 太感谢你们了，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]。愿我们同你们一道得偿所愿。
responses.en: We thank you, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]. May our people find what they are looking for, in communion with your people.

responses.zh: 那真是太不幸了，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]。希望那些掉队者能再坚持一下。我们马上就启程。
responses.en: That is unfortunate, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]. Hopefully the stragglers will endure for a while longer. We will be on our way.

texts.zh:
愿你沐浴和风，[Root.GetAdj][Root.GetRulerTitle]。我们发现你们称之为[NomadMissionPlanet.GetName]的球体目前并未被你们占据。我们请求：能否让我们的一支帝国在此安家？

我们知道这是个不小的要求——失去整座星系来给我们一个家。我们等待你的答复，无论你如何决定。
texts.en:
Pleasant winds to you, [Root.GetAdj] [Root.GetRulerTitle]. We have found that the orb you call [NomadMissionPlanet.GetName] is not currently being held by your people. We ask of you: could you let one of our tribes land upon it and make it a new home?

We realize we ask much of you - to lose an entire system to give our people a home. We await your decision, whatever it may be.

label.en: We cannot grant you this wish.

responses.zh: 这对我们而言是个噩耗，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]。希望他们能在下一个水坑中找到苦苦搜寻的目标，而不是灼热的风暴。通讯终止。
responses.en: That is unfortunate for our people, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]. We can only hope that they will find what they are looking for at the next watering hole, instead of searing winds. End transmission.

tooltips.en: Your relation with the [nomad_fleet_country.GetName] is worsened

responses.zh: 这对我们而言是个噩耗，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]。希望他们能在下一个水坑中找到苦苦搜寻的目标，而不是灼热的风暴。通讯终止。
responses.en: That is unfortunate for our people, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]. We can only hope that they will find what they are looking for at the next watering hole, instead of searing winds. End transmission.

tooltips.en: Your relation with the [nomad_fleet_country.GetName] is worsened

label.zh: 不，这是我们不可冒犯的领地。
label.en: No, it is ours by divine right.

responses.zh: 这对我们而言是个噩耗，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]。希望他们能在下一个水坑中找到苦苦搜寻的目标，而不是灼热的风暴。通讯终止。
responses.en: That is unfortunate for our people, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]. We can only hope that they will find what they are looking for at the next watering hole, instead of searing winds. End transmission.

tooltips.en: Your relation with the [nomad_fleet_country.GetName] is worsened

label.zh: 这座星系，以及那个“球体”归你们了。
label.en: The system, and the "orb" is yours.

responses.zh: 我们衷心感谢你们。在冰冻刺骨的星系中，这样的热情能够驱散一丝寒意。我们游牧舰队衷心祝愿你们以及新生的帝国前途光明。
responses.en: We thank your people for their grace. The galaxy is a cold place but today an act of kindness will ripple through its waters. We of the nomadic fleet wish both you and this new empire the best of luck in your affairs.

tooltips.zh:
你将割让[NomadMissionPlanet.GetStarName]星系的控制权

在[NomadMissionPlanet.GetName]上创建一个拥有1.5K£pop£的纳马里安族帝国

你与[nomad_fleet_country.GetName]以及纳马里安帝国的关系得到了改善
tooltips.en:
You will cede control of the [NomadMissionPlanet.GetStarName] System

Creates a Namarian empire with 1.5K £pop£ Pops on [NomadMissionPlanet.GetName]

Your relation with the [nomad_fleet_country.GetName] and the Namarian empire is improved

label.zh: 为什么对这颗行星感兴趣？
label.en: Why is the planet of interest?

responses.zh:
在虚空之河航行对十分艰难，却只是漫长旅程的一小步。我们的帝国只想寻求栖息之地，而[NomadMissionPlanet.GetName]能够满足他们的需求。

[Root.GetAdj][Root.GetRulerTitle]，你们愿意为他们提供栖息之地吗？
responses.en:
Sailing the voids-between is an arduous journey, and yet only a step on an already strenuous path. Our people simply seek rest, and thought that [NomadMissionPlanet.GetName] fulfilled their needs.

Will you grant them this rest, [Root.GetAdj] [Root.GetRulerTitle]?

texts.zh:
很高兴再会，绿洲的[Root.GetRulerTitle]。在周围的行星之间穿行使得我们可以在废弃种群找寻有用的东西。也正因如此我们刚刚建好了我们的新飞船。

事实上我们建造出过量的飞船是为了解决的资源过剩这个问题。我们更希望商队能够保持灵活，不受束缚，所以我们带着希望达成交易的愿景来找到你们。
texts.en:
Greetings again, [Root.GetRulerTitle] of the oasis. Sailing through the nearby stars have made for some particularly fruitful scavenging. And so we have just finished the construction of new vessels.

In actuality we build more than we need in order to get rid of the excess resources. We prefer the caravan to stay nimble, unburdened, so we come to you with a transaction in mind.

responses.zh:
舰队中的方舟。是我们的建设者工作休息的地方。商队穿梭于宇宙之中需要它来提供维持生存的空间，因此我们需要降低它的负载。

如果飞船组成了舰队的手臂的话，那么商队就是舰队的心脏。
responses.en:
The arkships of our fleet. Where we construct our contraptions, where our builders sleep. Steering the caravan across the great voids-between requires it to offer living space, hence the need to reduce its load.

If our military make up the fleet's hands, the caravan is its heart.

texts.zh: 我们有一个提案。我们需要能量币和矿物来维持我们的航行。作为交换，我们会交给你们五艘我们的新型舰船
texts.en: A proposal, then. We require energy credits and minerals for the next crossing. In exchange, you may have five of our newly-built vessels.

responses.zh: 我们想卖的就是这么多。毕竟商队需要攻防兼备。
responses.en: That is as many as we are willing to part with. The caravan needs its hands to hold both shield and spear after all.

label.zh: 我们不相信纳马里安的工程技术。
label.en: We do not trust Namarian engineering.

texts.zh:
这就是我们的行事方式，不断的收集资源，随时保持我们的船坞处于运作状态，这不仅仅是我们的传统也是我们必须要做的事。比起拖累我们的舰队我们更希望看到的是我们的造物被其他天体居民买去使用。

我们能够确信我们的设计不会让你失望。
texts.en:
It is our way, by tradition and necessity, to scavenge resources and activate our internal shipyards when and where we can. We would prefer to see whatever excess we generate is put to use among the orb-dwellers, than have it hamper our journey.

We believe our designs would not disappoint you.

label.zh: 给我介绍介绍这些舰队。

responses.zh: 巡洋舰，你们应该是这么叫的吧。装备有护盾，以及电弧发射器和等离子发射器。
responses.en: Cruisers, we suppose you would call them. Shielded and armed with plasma throwers and arc emitters.

texts.zh: 一个令人心旷神怡的回答，[Root.GetAdj][Root.GetRulerTitle]，我们只需2000£minerals£或者2000£energy£作为回报。
texts.en: A refreshing answer, [Root.GetAdj] [Root.GetRulerTitle]. All we ask in return is £minerals£ 2000 or £energy£ 2000.

label.en: We will happily ease your burden for £energy£ 2000.

texts.zh:
舰船将开往你们的中央绿洲——[Root.Capital.GetName]？是的。30天内完成交付。

愿你们一路顺风，永远能够得到荫凉的庇佑，[Root.GetRulerName]。
texts.en:
The ships will be driven to your central oasis - [Root.Capital.GetName]? Yes. To be delivered within 30 days.

May you always follow the trail and find shade, [Root.GetRulerName].

texts.zh:
嗨，天体居民。

我们有消息要告诉你们。
texts.en:
Hey, orb-dweller.

We've got some news for your kind.

label.zh: 纳马里安人，请表明身份。

responses.zh: 我们的身份并无特殊之处。我们是逐浪者舰队中的热心人士。
responses.en: We're no one special. A concerned party among the Pursuing Waters fleet, one might call us.

texts.zh:
你们最近是不是买来了5艘我们新制造的舰船，对吧？速度快而且装配着有大口径的武器？

事情是这样的，尽管你们不是……啊算了，我还是老实告诉你们吧。为了维护这片区域的稳定，和我们定下这笔舰船交易的国家可不止你们。你们的邻居，[other_empire.GetName]同样也和逐浪者舰队谈成了买卖。
texts.en:
You've recently purchased 5 of the fleet's newly crafted vessels, correct? Swift of speed, with large weapons?

Here's the thing, though, you weren't... ah, given the full story. In the interest of preserving regional stability, your people were not the only one offered this deal. Your neighbors, the [other_empire.GetName] have also parleyed with the Pursuing Waters.

texts.zh: 他们谈下了一笔差不多的买卖，又有5艘舰船即将被送往[other_empire.GetAdj]的首都[other_empire.Capital.GetName]。但我们并不希望舰队里的这些船最后是为[other_empire.GetName]效力，所以现在想要请你们帮帮忙。
texts.en: They accepted a similar offer, and 5 additional craft are set to be shipped to the [other_empire.GetAdj] oasis of [other_empire.Capital.GetName]. We would rather the fleet's ships do not end up in service of the [other_empire.GetName], and we would like your help.

responses.zh: 我们不相信[other_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，与我们之前遇到的其他的帝国不同，他们到现在都没有付款，我们怀疑他们在试图拖延付款时间直到舰船送达到他们的首都，然后再拒绝付款。因为他们意识到了我们的舰队领导非常急切的渴望离开这片星域……
responses.en: We do not trust the [other_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural], unlike the rest of the fleet. They have yet to pay, and we suspect they may try to stall until the vessels are delivered and then never send us payment. They realize the fleet leaders are very eager to move on...

responses.zh: 我们有进入商队船坞自动驾驶设置的权限。只要命令所有舰队在[Root.Capital.GetName]集结，禁止理应交付的那一半飞船发往[other_empire.Capital.GetName]的[other_empire.GetAdj]天体即可。我们不会被逮到的。
responses.en: We have privileged access to the autopilot configurations in the caravan's shipyards. Simply setting all vessels to rally at [Root.Capital.GetName] - and not sending half of them to the [other_empire.GetAdj] orb of [other_empire.Capital.GetName] - is trivial for us. We wouldn't even get caught.

label.en: What do you want us to do?

texts.zh: 我们需要得到实际的利益。就算是能够确保得到£energy£1000也比[other_empire.GetAdj]天体居民的承诺靠谱。
texts.en: We would need something to show for it. Even £energy£ 1000 would be more than whatever the fleet would get out of the [other_empire.GetAdj] orb-dwellers.

texts.zh: 愿荫凉庇佑你们，[Root.GetRulerName]。舰船会如约到达目的地——一艘不少。祝顺利。
texts.en: Shade upon you, [Root.GetRulerName]. The ships will arrive at the appointed time - all of them. Fair winds.

texts.zh:
真是太不幸了。

愿凉爽的白天和温暖的夜晚常伴你们左右，天体居民。
texts.en:
That is unfortunate.

Cold days and warm nights to you, orb-dweller.

texts.zh: 按照我们与逐浪者游牧舰队的协定，5艘武装飞船已经运输到了[Root.Capital.GetStarName]星系，正停驻在我们首都的轨道上。
texts.en: As per our agreement with the Pursuing Waters nomadic fleet, 5 military vessels have been delivered to the [Root.Capital.GetStarName] system and are orbiting our capital.

texts.zh: 按照我们与逐浪者游牧舰队以及其中的擅入者的合约——两支舰队总共10艘武装飞船已经运输到了[Root.Capital.GetStarName]星系，正停驻在我们首都的轨道。
texts.en: As per our agreement with the Pursuing Waters nomadic fleet - and the conscientious interloper in its midst - two fleets totaling 10 military vessels have been delivered to the [Root.Capital.GetStarName] system and are orbiting our capital.

texts.zh: 我们清楚自己产品的价值，天体居民。我们要的不多。
texts.en: We know what our creations are worth, orb-dweller. We do not ask for much.

label.en: We will happily ease your burden for £energy£ 2000.

texts.zh: 我们本希望至少能赚回制造成本，但现在只需要1500£minerals£或者1500£energy£就可以把飞船卖给你们。
texts.en: We had hoped to at least make back the manufacturing costs, but we can give you the ships for £minerals£ 1500 or £energy£ 1500.

label.zh: 我们非常乐意为你们分担1500£energy£。
label.en: We will happily ease your burden for £energy£ 1500.

label.zh: 我们愿意为之支付1500£minerals£矿物。

texts.zh:
真是太不幸了。

愿凉爽的白天和温暖的夜晚常伴你们左右，天体居民。
texts.en:
That is unfortunate.

Cold days and warm nights to you, orb-dweller.

texts.zh: 炎热而干旱。那真是不幸。我们原以为[Root.GetName]能够成为我们飞船最好的避风港。
texts.en: Heat and drought. That is unfortunate, we think the [Root.GetName] would have made a fine harbor for our vessels.

texts.zh: 愿凉爽的白天和温暖的夜晚常伴你们左右，[Root.GetAdj][Root.GetRulerTitle]。
texts.en: Cold days and warm nights upon you, [Root.GetAdj] [Root.GetRulerTitle].

texts.zh: 祝福你们，[Root.GetAdj][Root.GetRulerTitle]。希望你们相处愉快。
texts.en: Pleasant winds to you, [Root.GetAdj] [Root.GetRulerTitle]. We hope you are doing well.

texts.zh: 你们有什么要求，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]？
texts.en: What do you want, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]?

label.zh: 再多给我们讲讲你们的帝国。
label.en: Tell us more about your people.

responses.zh:
正如我们初步和谈时说过的，我们来自逐浪者舰队。我们世世代代穿梭于恒星间的虚无太空，且将世代延续下去。

舰队由许多个体组成，所有人都必须为了我们的目标倾尽全力。有些人希望脱离出去，在天体上殖民，但大多数人都想穿越下一片虚空，看看之后的景象。
responses.en:
As we mentioned at our introductory parley, we are the people of the Pursuing Waters fleet. We have traveled the stars and the voids-between for many generations, and will continue to do so for many more.

The fleet hosts a collection of individuals who all are required to do their best to enable our progress. Some wish to leave and establish a new orb-bound life for themselves, but most wish to see what lies beyond the next void.

label.zh: 再多给我们讲讲你们的帝国。
label.en: Tell us more about your people.

responses.zh: 请恕我们不愿透露，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]。还有别的事吗？
responses.en: We would rather not say, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]. Was there anything else?

responses.zh: 我们正沿着多条虚空之河进行探索。这场旅程已经持续千年，但我们仍将继续航行。我们的目标是宇宙的星辰大海。虽然听起来可能有些晦涩难懂，但这充分总结了我们的理想。愿它能为你们遮蔽烈日。
responses.en: We are on a journey down the river of the many voids-between. It has been millennia, but we sail on. The destination we seek being the ocean of the universe. It might sound cryptic, but this adequately summarizes what we dare share. May it bring you shade.

responses.zh:
鉴于你是逐浪者信任的盟友，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]，我将会告诉你一些事：

舰队目前正处于探索之中。我们的先祖曾经不得不离开母星驶向无垠的深空之中。他们希望我们能够找到我们存在的意义，在他们离开满是沙丘的母星千年之后，我们依旧依照着他们的当初的愿景来制定我们的生存之道。

这就是我们想说的。望你安康。
responses.en:
Being the trusted ally of the Pursuing Waters that you are, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj], we will tell you this:

The fleet is on a quest. Our ancestors had to leave our birthing orb behind and set sail down the back of night. They wished for us to find the purpose of our people, and we live today by that wish, millennia after they first left the sandy dunes of Home.

That is all we dare share. May it bring you shade.

responses.zh: 请恕我们不愿透露，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]。还有别的事吗？
responses.en: We would rather not say, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]. Was there anything else?

responses.zh: 祝顺利，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]。
responses.en: Favorable winds, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj].

texts.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]，愿灼热的太阳与残酷的干旱常伴你们左右。逐浪者永远不再与你们往来。
texts.en: Scorching suns and drought upon you, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]. The Pursuing Waters shall not deal with your sort ever again.

texts.zh: 你当见识怒涛的咆哮，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]!
texts.en: You shall know the fury of the Raging Waters, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]!

texts.zh: 逐浪者舰队上的游牧船员们给我们发来了信息。他们说他们正在从星系边缘离开并向下一个目的地进发。他们将会去哪？他们会找到他们正寻觅的东西吗？
texts.en: The galactic nomads aboard the Pursuing Waters fleet have sent us a parting message. They are leaving our galaxy from the outer rim and setting sail towards their next destination. Where will they end up next? Will they ever find what they are searching for?

summary.text:
# 银河游牧民 / Galactic Nomads

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/namarian_events.txt, common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

游牧舰队由 namarian.1 创建（events/namarian_events.txt:11-212；触发条件 has_megacorp = no 且 nomad01_country 尚不存在，即只创建一次），在银河边缘选出中点和终点；隐藏的舰队事件 namarian.2/3 控制航行：进入有主星系时停留约100天与其主人联络（若对方不敌对、未联络过），否则继续赶路或停在无主星系。
The fleet is created by namarian.1, travels rim -> midpoint -> end point (namarian.2/3/7/8) and stops in owned systems to make contact.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. namarian.10 “银河游牧民”：舰队代言人与你首次联络（经首次接触机制，common/scripted_effects/first_contact_effects.txt 的 finish_first_contact_effect）；你选择友好 / 疏远 / 威胁（按伦理的多种措辞；影响间谍网络增长 ±33%）；设标记 nomads_contacted。
   Contact: friendly, distant or hostile replies; sets nomads_contacted.
2. 停留期间，隐藏的舰队事件 namarian.4 随机（30 / 30 / 30 / 10 忽略；按宗教平等/亲异加成、已有的次数衰减）选出一项请求：
   While in your space, hidden namarian.4 picks (30/30/30/10 ignore) one request:
   - namarian.20 → 21 “银河游牧民”：请你收留一部分游牧人口（+300 游牧人口到指定行星；两个可追问的问题）。 Take in nomad pops (+300).
   - namarian.40 → 41：请你让出一颗未殖民的行星，创建一个纳马里安帝国（约1500人口），你交出整个恒星系，关系变化。 Cede a system to found a Namarian empire.
   - namarian.499 → 500 “游牧民的贸易提议”：用 2000 能量或矿物买 5 艘新舰（可讨价到 1500）；买下后 514 → 30天内交付（530）；还可能收到加密通讯 520-522：邻国也被卖了同样的船，请你出价（1000 能量）让他们的船不交到邻国手中（523/524/526）；拒绝则 525。 Sell ships, with an optional encrypted-message intrigue.
3. namarian.30 “游牧舰队”：任何时候通过外交菜单（on_custom_diplomacy，common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:714）与舰队交谈：了解他们的族群、目的地；回答按关系而不同。
   The diplomacy menu (30) answers questions about their people and destination.
4. 被攻击：on_entering_battle（common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1370）→ 隐藏 namarian.99：舰队被不曾联络过的势力或已联络的势力攻击后，向攻击者发 100 “急迫通讯”（再也不与你交易）或 105 “宣战声明”（50/50）。 Attacked -> 100 or 105.
5. 到达终点：namarian.8 删除舰队，并向所有联络过的玩家国发 namarian.9 “告别”。 End point -> 9 farewell.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- namarian.4 的请求互斥（收留 / 让出行星 / 卖船 / 忽略）。 The requests are exclusive.
- 交易线内的分叉：购买（能量 / 矿物 / 讨价）、拒绝；密报线：出价或不出价。 Inner choices in the trade chain.
- 被攻击后 100 与 105 互斥（各约50%，另有修正）。 100 and 105 are exclusive.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 请求按联络国的伦理（亲异、平等、唯灵加成；允许奴隶制则减少）与是否有合适的行星而变；创建事件要求 has_megacorp = no（注释：游牧民无法与商队竞争）。 Requests depend on ethics and available planets; the creation event requires has_megacorp = no.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：namarian.1-10、20/21、30、40/41、499-530、95-105 的触发与分派；20/40/15（战争任务）等隐藏事件未全部展开。
- 更正 Corrections：五个独立故事（3、8、10、30、99）并为一个“银河游牧民”；首次接触之前的“经由 finish_first_contact_effect 的广泛外链”只是编译器的展开，实际上只有 namarian.10。
  Five separate stories merged; the many first_contact.* callers shown for namarian.10 are an artefact of finish_first_contact_effect.
- 不确定 Uncertain：namarian.15（战争任务）等未列入本故事的分支未审阅。
